::: {.lead}
The evidence behind each phase. At the end of a phase the reviewer runs `make gate PHASE=N`, checks every acceptance criterion and invariant, and writes down what passed, what failed and what was fixed.
:::

Every story in every phase is done. The result column quotes each report on the day of its gate. The steps a report left open need a live model, a real GitHub account or the eval VM, and each report lists them under "Steps to close the gate".

::: {.gates-summary}
